item.content:encoded:
It's pretty funny. I like the direction of the joke, and the escalation is pretty well-constructed.

One thing I noticed, though: a lot of the humor in this article, and also in several of your other -J articles, comes from the weird names for things and irreverent tone. "NECROTIZING FUCKTROCUTION", "FRITO/BANDITO-CLASS", "ENJOY YOUR DESSICATED CORPSE, NERD", etc.. The question begged here is: why are those actually included?

Like, if the joke had something to do with the O5 Council being immature (which it sort of does, but not on this level), or was trying to make some point about weird punishments, then it'd make more sense, but that's not what the joke is about, really. It's just… odd, silly names thrown in such that they're odd, silly names. The Foundation is still basically the Foundation in the context of this article, so why would this be included?

My main other quibble would be that the last joke is a bit too easy to spot. "This thing is going to kill nobody" is possibly the least natural way to word that sentence ("this thing isn't going to kill anybody", for example, sounds much more natural) and as a result the final joke is a bit standard (maybe it would be funnier if it actually did kill Nobody? Then again, that would just invalidate the whole joke, wouldn't it. This is why I don't write -J's.).

Anyways: could be better, but otherwise pretty solid. Made me laugh, and earns my cautious upvote.
